nodes.title: Grade 11
nodes.description: Grade 11

nodes.title: Mathematical Literacy
nodes.description: Mathematical Literacy — Grade 11 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1 — SBA: Investigation and controlled test

assessmentStandards: Investigation
Controlled Test

nodes.title: Patterns and Relationships
nodes.description: Patterns and Relationships — exploring linear, inverse proportion, and constant ratio relationships; comparing tariff systems and banking options using multiple representations.

metadata.capsReference: Mathematical Literacy Grade 11 Term 1: Patterns and Relationships (Weeks 1–3)
assessmentStandards: Identify and work with constant difference relationships (two relationships)
Identify and work with inverse proportion relationships (two relationships)
Identify constant ratio between consecutive terms
Work with combinations of any two relationship types
Represent relationships using equations and formulae
Distinguish between dependent and independent variables
Represent relationships using tables and graphs
Use formulae, equations, tables and graphs to compare different tariff systems, banking options, etc.

nodes.title: Measurements
nodes.description: Measurements — unit conversions, time, equivalent proportionality, measuring and estimating, and calculating perimeter, area, surface area and volume.

assessmentStandards: Convert between metric and imperial units
Convert between Celsius and Fahrenheit temperatures
Calculate duration in hours and minutes (and vice versa)
Apply equivalent proportionality conversions (e.g., 5 litre paint covers 20 m²)
Measure and estimate length, distance, mass/weight, volume and temperature
Calculate perimeter of 2D shapes
Calculate area and surface area of 2D and 3D shapes
Calculate volume of 3D objects
Perform cost calculations related to measurements

nodes.title: Finance
nodes.description: Finance — financial documents, personal and business income, and personal and business expenditure.

assessmentStandards: Interpret financial document terminology and perform related calculations
Identify and calculate fixed, variable and occasional income
Calculate personal income including salaries, wages and commission
Calculate business income including sales, donations and grants
Identify and calculate personal expenditure including living expenses, personal tax and loan repayments
Identify and calculate business expenditure including taxes, salaries and running expenses

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 1 content.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2 — SBA: Assignment and mid-year examination

assessmentStandards: Assignment
Mid-Year Examination

nodes.title: Finance
nodes.description: Finance — taxation, tariff systems and comparing options using calculations and graphs.

assessmentStandards: Calculate and interpret VAT
Calculate and interpret UIF
Work with exchange rates
Interpret and apply municipal tariff systems
Interpret and apply telephone tariff systems
Interpret and apply transport tariff systems
Interpret and apply bank fees
Compare two financial options by performing calculations
Draw and interpret graphs to compare two financial options

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Maps, Plans and Other Representations — scales, map types, and reading directions and point locations.

metadata.capsReference: Mathematical Literacy Grade 11 Term 2: Maps, Plans and Other Representations (Weeks 4–5)
assessmentStandards: Read and use number scales
Read and use bar scales
Read and interpret seating plans
Read and interpret layout plans
Read and interpret street maps
Read and interpret road and rail maps
Read and interpret residential maps
Determine directions and point locations from maps

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Data Handling — developing questions, collecting data, summarising, representing and interpreting data.

metadata.capsReference: Mathematical Literacy Grade 11 Term 2: Data Handling (Weeks 6–8)
assessmentStandards: Develop appropriate questions for data collection
Identify populations and samples for data collection
Select appropriate data collection methods and instruments
Classify and organise data using tallies and frequency tables
Calculate mean, median, mode and range
Analyse data using measures of central tendency and spread
Represent data using multiple bar graphs
Represent data using line and broken line graphs
Represent data using scatter plots
Interpret and analyse multiple bar graphs, line graphs and scatter plots

nodes.title: Probability
nodes.description: Probability — simple events (revision), relative frequency, theoretical probability, and compound events using tree diagrams and two-way tables.

assessmentStandards: Revise outcomes, events and the probability scale
Determine and interpret relative frequency
Determine and interpret theoretical probability
Use tree diagrams to determine outcomes and probabilities of compound events
Use two-way tables to determine outcomes and probabilities of compound events

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 2 content.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3 — SBA: Assignment and controlled test

assessmentStandards: Assignment
Controlled Test

nodes.title: Finance
nodes.description: Finance — income and expenditure, cost and selling price, break-even analysis, interest, loans, banking and inflation.

assessmentStandards: Calculate income, expenditures, profit and loss for large organisations and fundraising projects
Compare income and expenditure over two years
Work with projected vs actual budgets
Determine cost price and selling price for manufactured/produced goods
Determine an appropriate selling price based on cost of production
Calculate percentage profit on cost and selling price
Determine break-even values from formulae
Determine break-even values from graphs
Calculate interest for loans, investments and bank accounts (without formulae)
Distinguish between types of banking accounts: savings, cheque, fixed deposit, credit and debit
Calculate inflation rates
Calculate rate of increase/decrease due to inflation

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Maps, Plans and Other Representations — scaled building plans and 3D models using packaging.

metadata.capsReference: Mathematical Literacy Grade 11 Term 3: Maps, Plans and Other Representations (Weeks 6–9)
assessmentStandards: Read and interpret housing/building plans drawn to scale
Read and interpret elevation plans
Read and interpret design drawings
Investigate and work with models using packaging (e.g., actual cans and boxes)
Relate 2D plans/nets to 3D models

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 3 content.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4 — No SBA task; end-of-year examination

nodes.title: Maps, Plans and Other Representations
nodes.description: Maps, Plans and Other Representations — assembling objects by following step-by-step instructions.

metadata.capsReference: Mathematical Literacy Grade 11 Term 4: Maps, Plans and Other Representations (Weeks 1–2)
assessmentStandards: Follow instructions to assemble plugs
Follow instructions to assemble plastic models
Follow instructions to assemble unassembled wooden furniture
Follow instructions to set up cell phones and electrical appliances
Follow instructions to assemble children's toys

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of all Grade 11 content in preparation for the end-of-year examination.

nodes.title: End of Year Examination
nodes.description: End-of-year examination: Paper 1 (100 marks, 2 hours — Finance, Data Handling, Probability) and Paper 2 (100 marks, 2 hours — Maps/Plans, Measurements, Probability).

metadata.capsReference: Mathematical Literacy Grade 11 Term 4: End of Year Examination (Weeks 7–10)
assessmentStandards: Paper 1 (100 marks, 2 hours): Finance, Data Handling, Probability
Paper 2 (100 marks, 2 hours): Maps, Plans and Other Representations, Measurements, Probability
